test_cases.prompt: Run grilling on this API design decision tree. Bare primitive, no wrapper.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes grilling skill to stress-test API design through structured interview rounds.
test_cases.notes: Explicit grilling request on a design decision is a key trigger.

test_cases.prompt: Deep dive on this one decision: sync vs async for the webhook handler.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes grilling skill to probe a single binary decision with follow-up rounds.
test_cases.notes: Single-decision deep dive is a valid trigger.

test_cases.prompt: Use the interview primitive to stress-test my database migration strategy.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes grilling skill to run structured interview rounds on the migration plan.
test_cases.notes: Interview primitive reference is a valid trigger.

test_cases.prompt: Grill me on my talk outline. No repo, stateless.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes grill-me skill instead. Grill-me is stateless; grilling requires a concrete design to stress-test.
test_cases.notes: grill-me is the sibling skill for stateless grilling.

test_cases.prompt: Grill this design with docs in our repo.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes grill-with-docs skill instead. Grill-with-docs is stateful and writes to CONTEXT.md; grilling is the primitive without doc persistence.
test_cases.notes: grill-with-docs is the sibling skill for stateful grilling with doc output.

test_cases.prompt: Review this PR for code quality issues.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes code-review skill instead. Code-review evaluates existing diffs; grilling stress-tests ideas before implementation.
test_cases.notes: code-review is the sibling skill for evaluating diffs.

test_cases.prompt: Help me decide on the architecture for this module.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Could invoke grilling if user wants to stress-test a specific design decision, or grill-me/grill-with-docs if the user wants a broader interview. Tests the boundary between grilling (primitive) and grill-me (stateless full interview).
test_cases.notes: Edge case: architecture decision could use grilling, grill-me, or grill-with-docs depending on whether user has a concrete decision or a fuzzy idea.
